notes.title: the EXPLORE update has arrived!
notes.content:
Today we're excited to make the EXPLORE update available to everyone who owns BELOW.

While some hardy wanderers have already braved the dark & brutal depths, many others perished along the way.  The EXPLORE update is a new way to delve in with a less-punishing set of game rules.  We hope it'll be perfect for those returning to the game as well as inviting all-new players to enjoy the atmosphere of the game on their own terms.

If you fell in love with the original game experience, don't worry!  The unaltered game is still available, now called "SURVIVE" mode.  Simply choose which mode you'd like to play from the main menu.  Your progress in each mode is saved separately, so you're free to go back and forth without any trouble.

On top of this, we've also finally brought the game to PS4, where EXPLORE mode is also available.  To celebrate this update, we're putting the game on sale until April 14th, and we'll also be doing some giveaways on our [url=https://discord.gg/zK9RHCh]CAPY Discord[/url].  If you've got friends who you think might enjoy the new mode, this is a great time for them to check the game out!

[b]UPDATE[/b] The update + sale may not be live for everyone just yet.  We're working to resolve this ASAP!

Thanks for playing, everyone, and good luck exploring!

notes.title: EXPLORE mode preview beta!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Wanderers!
[/h1]As you may have heard, we're going to be updating BELOW with a new mode very soon.  This new mode, called "EXPLORE", will be launching alongside the new PS4 version as of April 7th, and we plan to make the update available to PC players via Steam on the same day.

EXPLORE mode has been created with community feedback in mind, and modifies many of the core rules of the game to encourage exploration for players who prefer a little more forgiveness than BELOW's original, ruthless design permitted.

[i](Don't worry - each mode has a dedicated save, allowing you to continue your progress in the original mode, now called "SURVIVE", whenever you wish.)[/i]

We've decided that we'd like to make this mode available a little early for PC players - this is both a sneak preview for CAPY's friends playing on PC, as well as a chance for us to ask the community's help in catching any last-minute issues with EXPLORE mode before we make it available to everybody on PC.

[h2]Here's how to opt in:
[/h2]- Install BELOW from your Steam library
- Right click on Below's icon and choose "properties"
- Choose the "BETAS" tab
- Enter the following code: [b]AIMHLSDAASMTCSPS[/b]
- Choose "Public - Explore Public Branch" from the drop down menu

[h1]See you Below![/h1]
We've also recently set up a CAPY discord, where you're invited to come and discuss BELOW and all of our other games.  You'll also find a list of changes in the new mode pinned in the #below channel there.

We can't wait to hear what you discover in the Depths!

https://discord.gg/uZrxeFw
